SELECT c.content_id AS contentId , c.title_ko AS titleKo , c.title_org AS titleOrg , TO_CHAR(c.release_year, 'YYYY') AS releaseYear , c.poster_url AS posterUrl , DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.overview, 300, 1) AS overview , (SELECT ROUND(AVG(mc.rating_score), 1) FROM member_content mc WHERE mc.content_id = c.content_id) AS avgRating , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.content_id = c.content_id) AS commentCnt FROM content c
AND ( UPPER(c.title_ko) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{title}) || '%' OR UPPER(c.title_org) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{title}) || '%' )
AND (
( DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.overview, #{k}) > 0 OR UPPER(c.title_ko) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{k}) || '%' OR UPPER(c.title_org) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{k}) || '%' )
)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_genre cg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = cg.genre_id WHERE cg.content_id = c.content_id AND g.name = #{genre} )
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.release_year) >= #{yearFrom}
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.release_year) <= #{yearTo}
ORDER BY
c.release_year ASC NULLS LAST
(SELECT AVG(mc.rating_score) FROM member_content mc WHERE mc.content_id = c.content_id) DESC NULLS LAST
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment uc WHERE uc.content_id = c.content_id) DESC
c.release_year DESC NULLS LAST
, c.content_id ASC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId , TITLE AS title , TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdDt FROM NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
AND (
TITLE LIKE '%' || #{k} || '%'
)
ORDER BY IMPORTANT DESC, CREATED_DT DESC, NOTICE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.content_id AS contentId , c.title_ko AS titleKo , c.overview AS overview , (SELECT LISTAGG(g.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY g.genre_id) FROM content_genre cg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = cg.genre_id WHERE cg.content_id = c.content_id) AS genres FROM content c LEFT JOIN content_embedding ce ON ce.content_id = c.content_id WHERE c.overview IS NOT NULL AND ( ce.content_id IS NULL OR ce.model != #{model} ) ORDER BY c.content_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_embedding (content_id, embedding, model) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{embedding, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{model})
mapper.select: SELECT content_id AS contentId , embedding AS embedding FROM content_embedding WHERE model = #{model}
